standard_prerequisites.name: The two derived tensor products in the base change diagram agree, so K tensor_A^L A' = K tensor_R^L R' = K tensor_{R[x]}^L R'[x]
standard_prerequisites.use: Identifies the base-changed complex over the polynomial presentation.

standard_prerequisites.name: Derived tensor product along the ring map R[x] -> R'[x] preserves relative pseudo-coherence

core_obligations: Choose a surjection R[x_1, ..., x_n] -> A presenting A as a finite type R-algebra (proof lines 21554-21554). Since A and R' are Tor independent over R, the base-change comparison lemma applied twice identifies K tensor_A^L A' with K tensor_R^L R' and then with K tensor_{R[x]}^L R'[x] (proof lines 21555-21564). By the pull-pseudo-coherent lemma the derived tensor product along R[x] -> R'[x] of an m-pseudo-coherent complex relative to R is m-pseudo-coherent relative to R', giving the claim (proof lines 21564-21565).
proof_roadmap: Present A over R and identify the derived base change over the polynomial ring (proof lines 21554-21564).
Apply the pull-pseudo-coherent lemma along the polynomial base change (proof lines 21564-21565).
